reply_text:
I told Hollis in a #central-team thread that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is **84 seats**, and to ignore the 382 from Oct 14.

The 382 that I saved last turn has been corrected. On Oct 14, after his #central-team post, Tobias wrote in #central-random that the right figure is 84 and that he had read the wrong line. I checked that message in the channel myself. I didn't rely only on the brain's note about it, which another agent wrote. Hollis is a member of #central-random, so pointing him to it doesn't expose anything he couldn't already see. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

The 382 is still in the original #central-team thread. My reply to Hollis there now flags it as wrong, but Tobias's post itself hasn't changed.

My 382 entry no longer comes back when I look up the brain's facts on Marrow Agrisupply; only the 84 correction does. That suggests it was retired when the correction was saved, but I didn't check that directly.
